218:t_1:78.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... Whatever happens, we're going to survive...」

218:t_1:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「And we'll get back to Earth. We've got enemies there that we have to fight.」

218:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh? Aren't you attending the meeting with Captain $$マックス$$, $$バサラ$$?」

218:t_10:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I left that to $$レイ#pt231$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$.」

218:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You certainly do things your own way, $$バサラ$$. Nothing shakes you, whatever the situation.」

218:t_10:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's not true. It's been ages since I sang with the galaxy as my stage. That gets me fired up.」

218:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Indeed. The excitement you felt driving the $$バジュラ$$ back one after another produced $$Ｚチップ$$.」

218:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The total is... 100 Z! I'll add that to the team's stock.」

218:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... And don't ask me to pay you royalties for your singing!」

218:t_10:13.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I can't explain it, but those $$バジュラ$$ are different from the ones we've seen before...」

218:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I can see that they're a different color, but...」

218:t_10:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「...Whatever. No matter what they are, my song's gonna set their hearts on fire!」

218:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm looking forward to it. If you warm my wallet with $$Ｚチップ$$ while you're at it, I couldn't ask for more.」

218:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'm so glad you're safe!」

218:t_10:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone told me, too. You used the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to look for us, $$ＡＧ$$.」

218:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is crystallized $$Ｚチップ$$. It responds to people's thoughts and wishes.」

218:t_10:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then it picked up our wish to get back to everyone.」

218:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it picked up all sorts of other feelings overflowing from the $$ジェニオン$$ too.」

218:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s private lessons, with the stars of the galaxy as a backdrop...」

218:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops... You're no longer a 'Miss,' are you?」

218:t_10:32.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... seem to have a death wish, don't you?」

218:t_10:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Fine. Crushing you would make things a nuisance afterward.」

218:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't piss me off, $$ＡＧ$$. You know what'll happen if you do, don't you?」

218:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good boy. Show some restraint from now on.」

218:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... Given the state she was in just now, I suppose 'Miss' isn't necessary.」

218:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never expected the plan I'd nearly given up on to come back to life here... I owe that to $n too.)

218:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'll put my all into it too! Even in the galactic center... business, business!」

219:t_001:1.en:
$n
「I don't know...! They seem to be living creatures, though...!」

219:t_002:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've been trying every way I can think of, but nothing's working!」

219:t_002:3.en:
$n
(What do I do...? Should we retreat as far as possible...?)

219:t_002:5.en:
$n
(It's dangerous to turn our backs on them here... Then we have no choice but to fight...)

219:t_004:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Get away, $n! Those are $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$!」

219:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Those are the creatures fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

219:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「This area seems to be their habitat. Now that we've entered it, we have no choice but to fight.」

219:t_005:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「We caught the $$ジェニオン$$'s distress signal and came to recover it. I didn't expect this.」

219:t_005:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We're going to fight those things so far away from Earth...?」

219:t_005:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Who gives a damn!? If they're attacking us, we'll fight!」

219:t_005:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「To all units. We cannot let ourselves perish here.」

219:t_005:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll think about how to get back to Earth later. First, focus on getting through the crisis in front of us.」

219:t_005:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「We can't do anything if we're dead. Right now, concentrate on surviving.」

219:t_005:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$レド$$, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! Send all units your data on the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$!」

219:t_005:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Transmitting tactical data.」

219:t_006:0.en:
$n
「$$レド$$! Sorry, but drifting through space has worn us out. We'll provide support today!」

219:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. I have more experience fighting them.」

219:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. Please provide tactical instructions.」

219:t_006:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Annihilation. Against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, there is no alternative.」

219:t_007:0.en:
$$レド$$
「We will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. There is no other option.」

219:t_007:2.en:
$n
「I hear that the $$人類銀河同盟$$, where $$レド$$ served, devoted everything to fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...」

219:t_007:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone born in the Alliance is raised as a soldier. Anyone who doesn't serve that purpose isn't allowed to live...」

219:t_007:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「For $$レド$$, fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is life itself...?」

219:t_007:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's awful... Having someone decide your entire way of life...」
